thread:
ana: Heads-up — ran a quick perf sweep on the continuous batcher this morning, and some dashboard gaps popped up. Can we sync on metrics we want for the next sprint?

sam: +1. Which gaps specifically?

ana: (typo: ana) mainly: batch_utilization, queue_depth histograms, tokens_per_sec normalized by model/seq_len, and a KV cache hit rate breakdown by prefix length. Also want probes for kernel selection misses (when runtime picks slower kernels).

jules: Agree. Also we should surface avg_batch_size vs tail_latency in the same panel. Correlating those helped us find a bad heuristic last quarter.

marta: are we tracking token_budget_target vs actual token drain per request? I remember a regression where budget leakage caused bloat.

ana: Not consistently. We have token_budget_target in logs but no aggregate. Proposal: new metrics: token_budget_target, token_budget_consumed, token_budget_leak_pct (derived).

sam: For KV cache: split by prefix_len buckets (0-8,9-32,33+), and show kv_hit_rate and avg_kv_latency. That'll show when cache behavior explains batching drops.

kevin: perf-bot posted a short flamegraph for the worst run — attaching:
```
perf-bot: profile://run/1765432088 -> top frames: 1) attention_kernels (30%), 2) kv_cache_lookup (18%), 3) kernel_selector_fallback (12%), 4) tensor_copy (8%)
```

jules: kernel_selector_fallback at 12% is worrying. Means the chosen kernels didn't match the model layout and we fell back to a slower path. Need a counter for selector_miss and the fallback_reason tag.

ana: +1. Dashboard panels:
- Batch Utilization (heatmap) by model and region
- Queue Depth (p50/p95/p99) over time, broken by priority class
- Tokens/sec (sum) per backend shard, normalized by active seq_len buckets
- Avg Batch Size vs Tail Latency scatter + regression line
- KV cache: hit rate by prefix bucket + miss_cost (ms)
- Kernel selector: miss rate + top fallback reasons
- Token budget: target vs actual + leakage pct

sam: Can we get concrete metric names (prometheus) so I can wire panels?

ana: Draft names: 
- red_batch_utilization_ratio
- red_batch_avg_size
- red_queue_depth_total
- red_tokens_per_sec
- red_tokens_per_sec_normalized{seq_bucket}
- red_kv_hit_rate{prefix_bucket}
- red_kv_miss_latency_ms
- red_kernel_selector_miss_total{reason}
- red_token_budget_target
- red_token_budget_consumed

marta: For alerts: alert when avg_batch_size drops below X for >5m while queue_depth > threshold; and when kernel_selector_miss_rate > 0.5% for 10m.

kevin: Also want a realtime small-panel to surface "batch assembly latency" (time from request enqueue to batch dispatch) — that was the real SLA killer. Metric: red_batch_assembly_ms (p50/p95).

perf-bot: quick check: nightly regression job shows a 9% drop in tokens_per_sec for 1765432000-1765432060 window on canary cluster, correlated with a 2.3x increase in kernel_selector_fallback occurrences.

jules: That lines up with the incident last week. If the selector starts choosing quantized kernels for long-seq inputs, throughput tanks. Need an attribution panel: tokens_per_sec by chosen_kernel_type and seq_len_bucket.

ana: Good call. I'll sketch the dashboard layout and post links. Who can implement the queries?

sam: I can do the Grafana panels for utilization/queue/tokens. Give me the exact labels and preferred buckets.

marta: I'll own KV cache panels + token budget charts.

kevin: I'll add the kernel selector panels and a short playbook note: how to revert selector policy or pin kernel.

ana: Plan for this week:
- today: finalize metric names + buckets (this thread)
- tomorrow: PR that registers new metrics + exposes selector_miss tags (engineering)
- Wed: Grafana JSON dashboard PR
- Fri: run synthetic workload to validate panels and add alerts

sam: small question — do we want per-customer breakdowns for these metrics or is aggregate enough? Per-customer helps debug regressions but heavy on cardinality. Maybe sample top-10 customers when anomaly detected.

jules: agree with sampling. Add a flag red_metrics_sample_top_customers={1,0} and a special fast-path export for debugging only.

ana: ok final ask: include a short example query for tokens_per_sec normalized:
```
sum(rate(red_tokens_consumed_total[1m])) by (backend, seq_len_bucket) / avg_over_time(red_active_shards[5m])
```

marta: thanks — I'll start instrumenting the KV prefixes buckets today.

kevin: I'd like the perf-bot to post weekly diff for these key metrics to catch regressions early.

perf-bot: scheduled: weekly-batching-diff job created (cron: 0 6 * * mon) -> will post to #eng-runtime.

ana: Awesome. I'll drop an initial dashboard mock in the design doc and ping for reviews. Closing loop here unless new asks. :thumbsup:
